theorem lg_target : LawfulFunctor PMF := by
  constructor
  -- Prove naturality of PMF.map
  intros α β γ f g
  ext pmf
  simp [PMF.map, Function.comp]
  -- Prove identity law
  intros α f
  ext pmf
  simp [PMF.map, id]
  -- Prove composition law
  intros α β γ f g
  ext pmf
  simp [PMF.map, Function.comp]
